How to use this calculator

  3. Keep a scenario, change an input and compare the results.

Use consistent units and check the assumptions below before applying the result.

How home equity loan is calculated

This estimate assumes a fixed annual rate, equal monthly payments and no separate escrow. Early payments contain more interest; over time the principal share grows as the balance falls. Formula: Monthly installment follows the fixed-rate loan equation. Use the displayed details to inspect the intermediate amounts and replace example assumptions with terms from your own quote or records.

Frequently asked questions

Home Equity Loan Calculator: what does the result include?

No. It is principal and interest only unless those costs are part of the financed principal. Add escrow and recurring fees when comparing it with a lender’s full payment.

Home Equity Loan Calculator: which assumptions matter most?

A longer term usually lowers each scheduled payment but gives interest more time to accrue. Compare total interest as well as the monthly amount.
